verdict.rationale: Moss documents a public v1 API reference. All actions are multiplexed through a `/v1/manage` endpoint using an `action` string, with operations such as `createWebSource`. Python and TypeScript SDKs and a CLI sit alongside it, so the product can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the HTTP API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: All API actions are multiplexed through the `/v1/manage` endpoint. Provide an `action` string plus the required fields for that operation.
`createWebSource` Crawl a website into an index; an index holds up to 20 web sources.
Install the Python or TypeScript SDK and run your first semantic search in minutes.
